name: cudafast-bonsai2-9b
description: Bonsai 2 9B CUDA text inference speedup track on DGX Spark (GB10, sm_121). Target: prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-9B-gguf @ 9e08fac9 file Ternary-Bonsai-2-9B-PQ2_0-MTP-Q8_0.gguf, Bonsai 2 9B (built from Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B; 32 layers, hybrid linear/full attention): a PQ2_0 ternary trunk with prism.hadamard v1 transforms and one in-file MTP layer in Q8_0, run by the PrismML llama.cpp fork vendored at llama.cpp/ through harness/llama_resident (llamacpp-resident) in the pinned bonsai9b-engine:v1 CUDA devel image. The scored binary is the Engine Protocol v1 adapter (harness/protocol-adapter) attached to one llama-resident per leg. Two speculative arms, selected by mtp-head.manifest.json spec.mode: native MTP via llama.cpp draft-mtp at participant-selected depth 1 to 6, or the pinned Prism DFlash2 block drafter Ternary-Bonsai-2-9B-DFlash2-Q8_0.gguf (same repository and revision) via llama.cpp draft-dflash at depth 1 to 15. No submission carries drafter weights. Scoring is single-stream and paired: official_pairs = 3 on one box (serial control then candidate per pair), one pair per prompt of the fixture's live_goldens (three chat-template coding prompts of 512 tokens, one unmeasured prefill warm-up pass, 128-step decode); official_pair_combine mean gates every pair against its own control leg then seals the mean of the per-pair composites (prefill_gain^0.25 * decode_gain^0.75), with 0.95 speedup floors and no official decode speedup ceiling. Ranked timed windows use benchd near-tie replay: timed_token_tolerance_per_thousand 40 and timed_token_near_tie_relative_gap 0.01; local modes stay exact-match. fixtures/bonsai2_9b_cuda_v1_track.json is the authority; editablePaths is the authority for what a submission may change.
